x-changelog.description: Drawings index responses now support multi-sheet number identity and serialization. Responses include `sheet_number` and `drawing_number`, while `number` remains display-formatted (`<drawing_number> (<sheet_number>)` when sheet number is present). Enablement is managed internally by the Drawings development team. Please contact your Procore Account Manager or Support to request enablement. When not enabled, endpoints keep current behavior.

x-changelog.summary: Sheet number support for v1 drawings update APIs
x-changelog.description: Drawings update APIs now accept optional `sheet_number` in update payloads when sheet-number support is enabled, allowing number updates to be disambiguated in multi-sheet workflows. Clients may also send `sheet_number: null` to clear an existing value. Update handling preserves canonical drawing numbers by stripping an echoed `(<sheet_number>)` suffix from `number` inputs before persistence. Enablement is managed internally by the Drawings development team. Please contact your Procore Account Manager or Support to request enablement. When not enabled, endpoints keep current behavior aside from allowing a clear.

x-changelog.summary: Update permits reuse of deleted drawing number
x-changelog.description:
Previously, the error `drawing number already in use` prevented user from updating a drawing with a deleted drawing number.
This change allows the drawing to be updated with that deleted drawing number.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Token
parameters.description: Client-generated UUID v4 identifying a create operation. Retrying with the same token returns the original result instead of creating a duplicate.

post.description:
Create a new Drawing Upload in the specified project.

It creates one `DrawingUpload`, which includes a `DrawingLogImport` and a `ProstoreFile` for each file uploaded. The Drawing Upload will be processed asynchronously after the response.
For additional information on using the Create Drawing endpoint, see [Direct Drawing Uploads](/documentation/tutorial-direct-drawing-uploads) tutorial.

drawing_area_id.description:
Drawing Area ID
*Required only if Drawing Area is turned on

get_info_from_filename.description: Get drawing title, number from filename

drawing_log_imports.description:
Array of Drawing Log Import parameters.
There should be one Drawing Log Import per file/Upload in the Drawing Upload.

upload_uuid.description: An Uploads objects uuid. Must be a pdf.

drawing_date.description:
Drawing date
*Required only if a drawing_id is provided

default_revision.description:
Default Revision for any Drawing Revisions in the Import
*Required only if a drawing_id is provided

drawing_id.description: Drawing ID to associate any created Drawing Revisions to

custom_field_%{custom_field_definition_i.description:
Value of the custom field. The data type of the value passed in corresponds with the data_type of the Custom Field Definition.
For a lov_entry data_type the value passed in should be the ID of one of the Custom Field Definition's LOV Entries. For a lov_entries data_type the value passed in should be an array of IDs of the Custom Field Definition's LOV Entries.
